Subject: Proposal to adopt trunk-based development

Hi all,

I'd like to propose that we move from long-lived feature branches to trunk-based development.

The main problem today is that branches live for a week or more, so merges are painful and reviews are huge. In trunk-based development, we merge small changes to main at least daily, hide unfinished work behind feature flags, and rely on the CI pipeline to keep main always releasable.

The prerequisites are a fast and reliable test suite, which we are close to, and a flag system, which we already have.

If you're interested, I'll set up a pilot with the platform team for one month and report back.

Thank you
